title: Homogeneous moment norm bound
statement: Let $n,r,k$ be positive integers, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ whose nonzero Fourier coefficients are all supported on sets of size $k$. Then the uniform $2r$ norm of $f$ is at most $\bigl((2rk-1)!!\bigr)^{1/(2r)}$ and at most $\sqrt{k!}$ times the uniform second norm of $f$.
caveat: As supplied, the formal conclusion has a conjunction whose second component is a real number rather than a proposition; the statement appears malformed, so the second bound cannot be faithfully confirmed.
